name: ToolCall
purpose: One function call: name, status, duration, input and output.
description: One function call by the agent: a plain-language title, the function name in monospace, a status pill, the run time, and a disclosure with the input and output as formatted code. Part of the Agent kit.

name.notes: Figma: Tool name — the function the agent called, shown in monospace (`search_docs`).

title.notes: Figma: Title — what the call does in plain language ("Searched the docs"). Defaults to `name`.

input.notes: Figma: Input — the arguments. Objects are shown as formatted JSON.

output.notes: Figma: Output — the result. Objects are shown as formatted JSON.

error.notes: Error message for `status="error"`; shown in place of the output.

duration.notes: Figma: Duration — run time in milliseconds

icon.notes: Replaces the wrench icon (e.g. the integration's logo)

onOpenChange.notes: Called when the person expands or collapses it

do: Write the title as what happened ("Searched the docs"), and keep the function name as a secondary label.
Collapse calls by default; open the one that failed.
Give an error a cause and a next step ("Reconnect Linear and try again").
forbidden: Never show secrets, tokens or personal data in the input or output — redact them first.
Never hide a failed tool call; keep it in the thread.
